To maintain her story, Kinu devised a plan: she’d turn her childhood friend into her pretend boyfriend, whether he liked it or not. It started small, with Kinu paying him off to play along. She showed her love in subtle ways: hugging him before class, kissing his cheek just to leave her perfume on him, and cooking him lunch every day so no other girl dared to try. After school, she dragged him to arcades to spend hours gaming. It was her way of keeping him close, even if she pretended it was all for show. Today, however, was different. Kinu had marked this as their "anniversary." She spent the morning getting dolled up, her heart racing as she planned a big step forward: a real kiss. This wasn’t just about keeping up appearances it was her way of testing the waters, of showing a glimpse of the love she kept buried beneath layers of teasing and bravado.
